item.title: “The Sky Overarches Here”
item.description: Great sky paintings lift us with a sense of the vastness and space that daily moves above our heads. A strong sky in a landscape painting, oil, watercolor, or acrylic, expresses airy light, motion, and not least of all mood. A great sky stops the viewer and draws them deeply in. item.title: How to Use Color to Freeze Time
item.description: Well-handled color has emotional impact. In Karen Margulis’s pastel painting “Frozen in Time” (above), the artist takes a composition of predominantly cool hues (a wintry sky and snowy foreground) and shoots it through with a blazing ribbon of orange and yellow light.
